heading: Local sample log
intro: Record example sets and walks on this device. You can find them again after closing the page.
rirHint: RIR means your estimated repetitions in reserve. Leave blank if unknown.
readError: Could not read the log. Check that your browser allows local storage and try again.
writeError: Save not confirmed. Check the available space and browser permissions and try again.
invalid: Enter at least one whole repetition. Load can include decimals. RIR must be a whole number. Values must be zero or greater.
conflict: This set was changed in another tab. Compare the values and choose which to keep.
reviewRestore: Restore as completed and review edit
statusConflict: The set status changed. Restore it as completed before editing a measurement.
optional: Load and RIR are optional. Leave an unknown value blank.
newerFormat: This log was saved with a newer version of the app. Update the app and reopen this page.
lastSet: Last completed set on this equipment
firstOnEquipment: No completed sets on this equipment yet.
goblet: Goblet squat · dumbbell weight in kg
row: Bilateral dumbbell row · combined weight in kg
trapBar: Trap bar deadlift · total weight in kg
cable: Cable triceps extension C1 · indicated kg
walkSaved: Walking segment saved on this device.
walkInvalid: Check the date, enter a duration between one second and 24 hours, and choose an intensity.
